67602.meaning1: feeling aversion; being disgusted; being sick of
67602.commentary: (NIDD1) vijigucchamānassā'ti jātiyā vijigucchamānassa, jarāya… byādhinā… maraṇena… sokehi… paridevehi… dukkhehi… domanassehi… upāyāsehi… diṭṭhibyasanena dukkhena vijigucchamānassa aṭṭīyamānassa harāyamānassā'ti, vijigucchamānassa.

examples.text: vijigucchamānassa yadidaṃ phāsu, ritt'āsanaṃ sayanaṃ sevato ce, sambodhikāmassa yath'ānudhammaṃ, taṃ te pavakkhāmi yathā pajānaṃ.
yāvatā, bhikkhave, kāsikosalā, yāvatā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa vijitaṃ, rājā tattha pasenadi kosalo aggam'akkhāyati.
no ce labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ, saddhiṃcaraṃ sādhuvihāridhīraṃ, rājā'va raṭṭhaṃ vijitaṃ pahāya, eko care mātaṅg'araññ'eva nāgo.
no ce labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ, saddhiṃcaraṃ sādhuvihāridhīraṃ, rājā'va raṭṭhaṃ vijitaṃ pahāya, eko care mātaṅg'araññ'eva nāgo.

67605.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: kāḷ'ūpakāḷā vijito jito ca, aṅgo ca paṅgo ca guttijito ca, passi jahi upadhidukkhamūlaṃ, aparājito mārabalaṃ ajesi.

67606.meaning1: who has won the battle; victorious in war; epithet of the Buddha
67606.meaning2: victorious, by whom the battle has been won

examples.text: uṭṭhehi vīra vijitasaṅgāma, satthavāha aṇaṇa vicara loke, desassu bhagavā dhammaṃ, aññātāro bhavissantī'ti.
so kho ahaṃ, mārisa moggallāna, taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tato paṭinivattitvā vejayantaṃ nāma pāsādaṃ māpesiṃ. vejayantassa kho, mārisa moggallāna, pāsādassa ekasataṃ niyyūhaṃ.

67608.meaning1: who has won victory; who has triumphed
67608.commentary: (MNa) sabbaputhujjane vijiniṃsu vijinanti vijinissanti vā'ti vijayā. ke te, maccumāra-kilesamāra-devaputtamārā'ti? te vijitā vijayā etenā'ti vijitavijayo. bhagavā, tassa vijitavijayassa.

examples.text: dhīrassa vigatamohassa, pabhinnakhīlassa vijitavijayassa, anīghassa susamacittassa, vuddhasīlassa sādhupaññassa, vesamantarassa vimalassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi

67609.meaning1: who has conquered; who has vanquished

examples.text: sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato. tass'imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti
usabhaṃ pavaraṃ vīraṃ, mah'esiṃ vijitāvinaṃ, anejaṃ nhātakaṃ buddhaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

67610.meaning1: having conquered; having won; having triumphed (over)

examples.text: rājā pasayhā pathaviṃ vijitvā, sasāgar'antaṃ mahimāvasanto, oraṃ samuddassa atittarūpo, pāraṃ samuddassa'pi patthayetha.
ye sattasaṇḍaṃ pathaviṃ vijitvā, rāj'isayo yajamān'ānupariyagā, assamedhaṃ purisamedhaṃ, sammāpāsaṃ vājapeyyaṃ niraggaḷaṃ.
adaṇḍena asatthena, vijeyya pathaviṃ imaṃ, asāhasena kammena, samena anusāsi taṃ, dhammena rajjaṃ kāretvā, asmiṃ pathavimaṇḍale.

67615.grammar: pr, pass of vindati, impers, intrans (+dat or +loc)

examples.text: icc'ete aṭṭha dhammā ca, yassā vijjanti nāriyā, tam'pi sīlavatiṃ āhu, dhammaṭṭhaṃ saccavādiniṃ.
etādis'āyaṃ santāno, māy'āyaṃ bālalāpinī, vadhako esa akkhāto, sāro ettha na vijjati.

67616.grammar: pr, pass of vindati, impers, intrans

examples.text: aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ, tapassi, anavakāso yaṃ upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagaccheyya. ṭhānañ'ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ samaṇo gotamo upālissa gahapatissa sāvakattaṃ upagaccheyya.
n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjativāro
yathā'pi dukkhe vijjante, sukhaṃ nāma'pi vijjati, evaṃ bhave vijjamāne, vibhavo'pi icchitabbako.
addasā kho maṃ, bhante, aññatarā itthī vijj'antarikāya bhājanaṃ dhovantī.
amatamhi vijjamāne, kiṃ tava pañcakaṭukena pītena, sabbā hi kāmaratiyo, kaṭukatarā pañcakaṭukena.
yathā'pi dukkhe vijjante, sukhaṃ nāma'pi vijjati, evaṃ bhave vijjamāne, vibhavo'pi icchitabbako.

67623.grammar: pr, reflx 3rd pl of vijjati, pass, intrans
67623.meaning1: they themselves exist; they themselves are found; they themselves are present

examples.text: andhakamakasā na vijjare, kacche rūḷhatiṇe caranti gāvo, vuṭṭhim'pi saheyyum'āgataṃ, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.

67624.synonym: anubodha, pajānanā, paññā, paññāṇa, bojjha, mona, veda

examples.text: pamādo rajo pamādo, pamād'ānupatito rajo, appamādena vijjāya, abbahe sallam'attano'ti.
ayaṃ kho me brāhmaṇa rattiyā pacchime yāme tatiyā vijjā adhigatā avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā tamo vihato āloko uppanno
kathañ'carahi, samaṇa, bhuñjasī'ti? ye hi keci, bhagini, samaṇabrāhmaṇā vatthuvijjātiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvikaṃ kappenti, ime vuccanti, bhagini, samaṇabrāhmaṇā adhomukhā bhuñjantī'ti.

67626.commentary: (DNa) gandhārī'ti gandhārena nāma isinā katā, gandhāraraṭṭhe vā uppannā vijjā. tattha kira bahū isayo vasiṃsu, tesu ekena katā vijjā'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ so assaddho appasanno taṃ saddhaṃ pasannaṃ evaṃ vadeyya, atthi kho, bho, gandhārī nāma vijjā.

67627.meaning1: wise; who understands; who has attained wisdom

examples.text: avijjā h'āyaṃ mahāmoho, yen'idaṃ saṃsitaṃ ciraṃ, vijjāgatā ca ye sattā, n'āgacchanti punabbhavan'ti.

taṃ kiṃ maññatha, sāḷhā, atthi amoho'ti? evaṃ, bhante. vijjā'ti kho ahaṃ, sāḷhā, etam'atthaṃ vadāmi. amūḷho kho ayaṃ, sāḷhā, vijjāgato n'eva pāṇaṃ hanati, na adinnaṃ ādiyati, na paradāraṃ gacchati, na musā bhaṇati, param'pi na tath'attāya samādapeti

67628.meaning1: understanding and action; wisdom and ethical conduct; theory and practice

examples.text: asso yathā bhadro kasāniviṭṭho, ātāpino saṃvegino bhavātha, saddhāya sīlena ca vīriyena ca, samādhinā dhammavinicchayena ca, sampannavijjācaraṇā patissatā, jahissatha dukkham'idaṃ anappakaṃ.
khattiyo seṭṭho janetasmiṃ, ye gottapaṭisārino, vijjācaraṇasampanno, so seṭṭho devamānuse'ti.

67629.meaning1: discussion about wisdom and ethical conduct
67629.meaning2: discussion about wisdom and ethical conduct

67630.meaning1: attainment of wisdom and ethical conduct
67630.meaning2: attainment of wisdom and ethical conduct

examples.text: ye hi keci ambaṭṭha jātivādavinibaddhā vā gottavādavinibaddhā vā mānavādavinibaddhā vā āvāhavivāhavinibaddhā vā, ārakā te anuttarāya vijjācaraṇasampadāya.

67631.meaning1: endowed with knowledge and conduct; accomplished in understanding and action; perfect in wisdom and moral conduct
67631.commentary: (ANa) vijjācaraṇasampanno'ti tīhi vijjāhi ca pañcadasahi caraṇadhammehi ca samannāgato.
67631.notes: see MN53 Sekhasuttaṃ for a good definition of vijjācaraṇasampanno

examples.text: iti'pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā'ti.
khattiyo seṭṭho janetasmiṃ, ye gottapaṭisārino, vijjācaraṇasampanno, so seṭṭho devamānuse'ti.

67632.meaning1: who makes an end through understanding and ethical conduct
67632.meaningLit: end making by knowledge and behaviour

examples.text: kiṃ pan'āvuso sāriputta, vijjācaraṇen'antakaro hotī'ti, iti puṭṭho samāno, no h'idaṃ, āvuso'ti vadesi. kiṃ pan'āvuso sāriputta, aññatra vijjācaraṇen'antakaro hotī'ti, iti puṭṭho samāno, no h'idaṃ, āvuso'ti vadesi.

67633.meaning2: subject of study, arts and sciences

67636.meaning1: related to wisdom; pertaining to understanding; playing a part in knowledge
67636.commentary: (MNa) vijjābhāgiyā'ti ettha sampayogavasena vijjaṃ bhajantī'ti vijjābhāgiyā. vijjābhāge vijjākoṭṭhāse vattantī'ti'pi vijjābhāgiyā. (ANa) vijjābhāgiyā'ti vijjākoṭṭhāsikā.

examples.text: dve me, bhikkhave, dhammā vijjābhāgiyā. katame dve? samatho ca vipassanā ca.
yassa kassaci, bhikkhave, kāyagatāsati bhāvitā bahulīkatā, ant'ogadhā'v'āssa kusalā dhammā ye keci vijjābhāgiyā.

67638.meaning1: who makes an end through understanding

examples.text: tasmā akhilo'dha padhānavā, nīvaraṇāni pahāya visuddho, mānañ'ca pahāya asesaṃ, vijjāy'antakaro samitāvī'ti.

67639.meaning1: attainment of wisdom; achievement of understanding

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, ambaṭṭha, bhikkhu vijjāsampanno iti'pi, caraṇasampanno iti'pi, vijjācaraṇasampanno iti'pi. imāya ca ambaṭṭha vijjāsampadāya caraṇasampadāya ca aññā vijjāsampadā ca caraṇasampadā ca uttaritarā vā paṇītatarā vā n'atthi.

67640.meaning1: endowed with knowledge; accomplished in understanding; perfect in wisdom

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako vijjāsampanno iti'pi caraṇasampanno iti'pi vijjācaraṇasampanno iti'pi.

67646.meaning1: liberation and understanding; release and discernment; (or) emancipation through wisdom

examples.text: satt'ime, brāhmaṇa, bojjh'aṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anupakkilesā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti. katame satta?
vijjāvimuttim'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sāhāraṃ vadāmi, no anāhāraṃ. ko c'āhāro vijjāvimuttiyā? satta bojjh'aṅgā'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ

67647.meaning1: for personal experience of the fruit of liberation and understanding
67647.construction:
vijjāvimutti + phalasacchikiriya + attha + aṃ
vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyattha + aṃ
67647.commentary: (SNt) vijjāvimutti-phalasacchikiriy'atthan'ti ettha vijjā'ti aggamaggavijjā. vimuttī'ti aggamaggasamādhi adhippeto. tesaṃ phalaṃ aññā'ti āha, vijjāvimuttiphalena arahattaṃ kathitan'ti.

examples.text: sace vo, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, kim'atthiyaṃ, āvuso, samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti, evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha… vijjāvimutti-phalasacchikiriy'atthaṃ kho, āvuso, bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī'ti…

67648.meaning1: personal experience of the fruit of liberation and understanding
67648.commentary: (ANa) vijjāvimutti-phalasacchikiriyāyā'ti vijjāvimuttīnaṃ phalassa paccavekkhakaraṇ'atthāya. ettha ca vijjā'ti maggapaññā, vimuttī'ti taṃsampayuttā sesadhammā. tesaṃ phalaṃ nāma arahattaphalaṃ, tassa sacchikiriyāyā'ti attho.

examples.text: satt'ime, brāhmaṇa, bojjh'aṅgā anāvaraṇā anīvaraṇā cetaso anupakkilesā bhāvitā bahulīkatā vijjāvimutti-phalasacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti. katame satta?

67649.meaning1: for the purpose of (experiencing) the fruit of release and discernment; (or) for the benefit of (experiencing) the fruit of liberation through understanding

examples.text: so tattha passāmi eke samaṇabrāhmaṇe itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃsañ'c'eva kathaṃ kathente upārambh'ānisaṃsañc'a, bhavaṃ pana gotamo kim'ānisaṃso viharatī'ti? vijjāvimuttiphal'ānisaṃso kho, kuṇḍaliya, tathāgato viharatī'ti.
kāmesu vinaya gedhaṃ, nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato, uggahītaṃ nirattaṃ vā, mā te vijjittha kiñcanaṃ.
idāni, bhante, deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balibaddā
idh'āgamā vijjupabhāsavaṇṇā, kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā, buddhañ'ca dhammañ'ca namassamānā, gāthā'c'imā atthavatī abhāsi.

67652.commentary: (THa) vijjutā carati nabhe'ti tattha tattha gajjatā gaḷagaḷāyatā mahāmeghato niccharantiyo sateratā ākāse ito c'ito ca vicaranti.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, pukkusa, katamaṃ nu kho dukkarataraṃ vā durabhisambhavataraṃ vā, yo vā saññī samāno jāgaro pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni nissāya nissāya atikkantāni n'eva passeyya, na pana saddaṃ suṇeyya, yo vā saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjutāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā n'eva passeyya, na pana saddaṃ suṇeyyā'ti?
dharaṇī ca siñcati vāti, māluto vijjutā carati nabhe, upasamanti vitakkā, cittaṃ susamāhitaṃ mamā'ti.

67653.meaning1: flash of lightning; streak of lightning

examples.text: idh'āgamā vijjupabhāsavaṇṇā, kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā, buddhañ'ca dhammañ'ca namassamānā, gāthā'c'imā atthavatī abhāsi.

67654.meaning1: with the appearance of a flash of lightning

examples.text: idh'āgamā vijjupabhāsavaṇṇā, kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā, buddhañ'ca dhammañ'ca namassamānā, gāthā'c'imā atthavatī abhāsi.

67655.meaning1: arising of understanding; birth of wisdom; appearance of knowledge

examples.text: kathaṃ pan'āvuso, āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti na hotī'ti? avijjāvirāgā kho, āvuso, vijj'uppādā taṇhānirodhā, evaṃ āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhinibbatti na hotī'ti.
idh'assa, vappa, kāyena saṃvuto vācāya saṃvuto manasā saṃvuto avijjāvirāgā vijj'uppādā. passasi no tvaṃ, vappa, taṃ ṭhānaṃ yatonidānaṃ purisaṃ dukkhavedaniyā āsavā assaveyyuṃ abhisamparāyan'ti?

67656.meaning1: wreathed in lightning; garlanded with lightning

examples.text: yathā hi megho thanayaṃ, vijjumālī satakkaku, thalaṃ ninnañ'ca pūreti, abhivassaṃ vasun'dharaṃ.

67657.meaning1: forks of lightning; flashes of lightning

examples.text: idāni, bhante, deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balibaddā

67658.commentary: (ADha) puna anajjhottharaṇabhāvena kilesandhakāraṃ viddhaṃsetuṃ asamatthatāya vijju upamā etesan'ti vijj'ūpamā.

examples.text: tayo'me, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame tayo? aruk'ūpamacitto puggalo, vijj'ūpamacitto puggalo, vajir'ūpamacitto puggalo.

67662.synonym: obhāsayanta, jalamāna, jotayanta, tapanta, tapamāna, virocamāna, sobhamāna

examples.text: tā disvā māṇavo kim'etan'ti ito c'ito ca vilokento addasa bhagavantaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ sant'indriyaṃ dvattiṃsāya mahāpurisalakkhaṇehi asītiyā anubyañjanehi byāmappabhāya ketumālāya ca vijjotamānaṃ anupamāya buddhasiriyā acinteyyena buddh'ānubhāvena virocamānaṃ.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu asicammaṃ gahetvā, dhanukalāpaṃ sannayhitvā, ubhatobyūḷhaṃ saṅgāmaṃ pakkhandanti usūsu'pi khippamānesu, sattīsu'pi khippamānāsu, asīsu'pi vijjotalantesu.
tassa kusakaṇṭakā c'eva pāde vijjheyyuṃ, sarapattāni ca gattāni vilekheyyuṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, purisaṃ sallena vijjheyya. tam'enaṃ dutiyena sallena anuvedhaṃ vijjheyya. evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, puriso dvisallena vedanaṃ vedayati.
te tattha usūhi'pi vijjhanti, sattiyā'pi vijjhanti, asinā'pi sīsaṃ chindanti. te tattha maraṇam'pi nigacchanti, maraṇamattam'pi dukkhaṃ.
ettha tuttaṃ vuccati kaṇṇamūle vijjhana-ayadaṇḍako. tomaran'ti pād'ādīsu vijjhanadaṇḍatomaraṃ.
agamāsi kho, bhikkhave, so kummo taṃ padesaṃ. tam'enaṃ luddo papatāya vijjhi.

67678.meaning1: to shoot; to hit a target

examples.text: ṭhānakusalo'ti yena ṭhānena ṭhito avirādhetvā vijjhituṃ sakkoti, tasmiṃ ṭhāne kusalo. sesaṃ heṭṭhā vuttanayen'eva veditabbaṃ.
āhaccapādako nāma mañco aṅge vijjhitvā ṭhito hoti. āhaccapādakaṃ nāma pīṭhaṃ aṅge vijjhitvā ṭhitaṃ hoti.
tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, luddo vijjhitvā tasmiṃ'y'eva kaṭṭhakat'aṅgāre avassajjetvā yena kāmaṃ pakkamati. evaṃ so taṃ, bhikkhave, hoti yo agocare carati paravisaye.

67682.grammar: prp of pass of √vidh, pass, intrans (+instr)

examples.text: sampajānamusāvādo nāma visaṃvādanapurekkhārassa vācā, girā, byappatho, vacībhedo, vācasikā viññatti, aṭṭha anariyavohārā, adiṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhaṃ me'ti, assutaṃ sutaṃ me'ti, amutaṃ mutaṃ me'ti
abandhan'okāso nāma patto yassa dv'aṅgulā rāji na hoti. bandhan'okāso nāma patto yassa dv'aṅgulā rāji hoti. navo nāma patto viññattiṃ upādāya vuccati.

67688.meaning1: asking too much; begging a lot
67688.commentary: (VINa) yācanā eva bahulā etesaṃ mandaṃ aññaṃ kamman'ti yācanabahulā. evaṃ viññattibahulā veditabbā. atthato pan'ettha nānākaraṇaṃ n'atthi, anekakkhattuṃ purisaṃ detha, puris'atthakaraṃ dethā'ti yācantānam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tattha mūlacchejjāya purisaṃ yācituṃ na vaṭṭati, sahāy'atthāya kammakaraṇ'atthāya purisaṃ dethā'ti yācituṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bahū gilāne bhikkhū upaṭṭhahantā yācanabahulā viññattibahulā viharanti, gilānabhattaṃ detha, gilān'upaṭṭhākabhattaṃ detha, gilānabhesajjaṃ dethā'ti. jīvako'pi komārabhacco bahū gilāne bhikkhū tikicchanto aññataraṃ rājakiccaṃ parihāpesi.

67689.commentary: (VINa) viññatti bahulā etāsan'ti viññattibahulā. viññattī'ti het'ūdāharaṇ'ādīhi vividhehi nayehi ñāpanā veditabbā, na yācanā.

examples.text: iti kho, bhikkhave, tathāgato… viññatvā viññātabbaṃ, viññātaṃ na maññati, aviññātaṃ na maññati, viññātabbaṃ na maññati, viññātāraṃ na maññati.

67691.meaning1: will comprehend; will understand; will recognize; will distinguish

examples.text: atthass'āyaṃ viññāpanī, upamā viññūhi desitā, viññassanti mahānāgā, nāgaṃ nāgena desitaṃ.

67692.meaning1: awareness; consciousness; cognition; mind; fifth of the five aggregates

examples.text: viññāṇaṃ viññāṇan'ti, āvuso, vuccati. kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, viññāṇan'ti vuccatī'ti? vijānāti vijānātī'ti kho, āvuso, tasmā viññāṇan'ti vuccati.
ettha dīghañ'ca rassañ'ca, aṇuṃ thūlaṃ subh'āsubhaṃ, etthamañ'ca rūpañ'ca, asesaṃ uparujjhati, viññāṇassa nirodhena, etth'etaṃ uparujjhatī'ti.
vīmaṃsakena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā parassa cetopariyāyaṃ ajānantena tathāgate samannesanā kātabbā sammāsambuddho vā no vā iti viññāṇāyā'ti.

67695.meaningLit: discourse on not making consciousness evident
67695.sanskrit: vijñāna + na + prātyakṣa + karman + sūkta, sūtra (bsk)

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dasannaṃ kasiṇ'āyatanānaṃ yadidaṃ viññāṇakasiṇaṃ eko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ. evaṃsaññino'pi kho, bhikkhave, santi sattā.

67698.commentary: (MNa) tattha viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ tāva dassetuṃ viññāṇakasiṇam'eke'ti vuttaṃ. parato ākiñcaññ'āyatanam'eke'ti vakkhati.

examples.text: etaṃ vā pan'ekesaṃ upātivattataṃ viññāṇakasiṇam'eke abhivadanti appamāṇaṃ āneñjaṃ. ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato abhijānāti.

67699.meaning1: classes of consciousness; categories of awareness

examples.text: cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha viññāṇakāyā veditabbā, cha phassakāyā veditabbā, aṭṭhārasa mano'pavicārā veditabbā, chattiṃsa sattapadā veditabbā
katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, viññāṇakāyā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manoviññāṇaṃ.
